source_prompt:
Production sprite source atlas for EMBERDELVE, a portrait dark-fantasy
dice roguelite about ordinary keepers of a dying underground forge. REDESIGN the
two lead characters as memorable working delvers, NOT generic cartoon knights.

Exactly TWO ROWS and FOUR COLUMNS on a truly transparent alpha background.
Eight isolated complete full-body pixel sprites. Each row is ONE consistent
character. Columns: 1 neutral combat-ready idle; 2 subtly different breathing
idle, SAME anatomy/costume/scale; 3 left-leg-forward walking; 4 right-leg-forward
walking. Same character model in all four columns, genuinely changed arms/legs.
All face RIGHT in a readable side-three-quarter view; all feet on same baseline.
Generous transparent gutters between cells. No text, no grid, no shadows,
no ground plane, no scenery, no border or decorative sparks.

CRITICAL LOW-RES ART DIRECTION: intended final native sprite 32 x 40 pixels.
Draw large clean pixel clusters, hard stepped edges, crisp outlines, 12-16
colours per character, no dithering or isolated noisy pixels. Approximate
5-head-high proportions, not chibi, not giant bobbleheads, no gradients or blur.
Anatomy must remain legible after nearest-neighbour reduction to 32x40.
Transparent negative space between legs and between forward arm and torso.
Keep every limb, shield and cape inside its cell. These are practical riggable
base bodies: no held primary weapons, no floating spell orb, NO baked-in sword,
staff, knife, hammer or torch. The game attaches its own blade/maul to the
visible forward empty gauntlet. Fingers may be a simple curled gripping fist.

ROW 1 — KINDLER, soot-worn firekeeper, lean and agile.
Strong asymmetric silhouette: narrow shoulders, small ash-grey half-hood
leaning backward, faded burnt-orange neck scarf with a short split tail to the
left, charcoal fitted workcoat to mid-thigh, ochre leather belt and a clearly
shaped tiny shuttered COAL LANTERN attached to the rear belt. No fire cape.
Practical ash-wrapped lower legs, dark angular boots, short tough leather
gloves, face mostly shaded but a pale cheek highlight and nose face right.
One thick glove is visibly extended forward at waist/chest level, bent elbow,
ready to hold the runtime short Ember Brand. Distinct slim triangular upper
silhouette, grounded worker not wizard. Warm orange is a restrained scarf
accent; most costume is cool charcoal/ash. No armor plate suit. No held weapon.

ROW 2 — WARDEN, heavy threshold guardian built like a furnace door.
Broader chest and shorter neck than Kindler, massive angular iron shoulder on
the near side, low enclosed steel kettle helm with a single narrow pale slit,
layered weathered charcoal plate, deep slate-blue cloth panel, iron-shod boots
in a wide braced stance. One distinct tall flat-faced TOWER SHIELD on the far
forward arm: dark iron rectangle with clipped bottom corners, ash-grey rim,
ONE muted gold vertical hinge, like a portable furnace door. Not glowing neon.
The near-side FREE GAUNTLET is clearly visible in front of the chest, bent
elbow reaching toward screen right, ready for a runtime maul. Shield starts
lower than the free hand so the wrist is not buried in it. No sword or mace
painted into the character. Warm forge rivets sparingly. Heavy grounded body,
not decorative horns, crowns, skull spikes, plume or superhero muscles.

Shared Emberdelve palette: ink #141019, dark #1E1826, charcoal #2A2136,
outline #3A3148, ash #EDE6DA, muted ash #9A8FA0; restrained orange #F08A2C,
gold #E8C24A and slate blue #5B8DD9, darker tints allowed. Strong value grouping,
readable against dark backgrounds. The two characters must be instantly
distinguishable in solid-black silhouette and by equipment, not mere recolours.
Keep side-view game-sprite staging, not illustrated character concept poses.
scope: Owner-requested two-character redesign; no gameplay changes.
refinement_prompt:
Refine the attached eight-figure sprite atlas into truly LOW-RES
game pixel art. Keep the two characters' identities and 2 rows x 4 columns:
Kindler soot-worn firekeeper above, Warden furnace-door shield bearer below.

The previous source's fine metallic texture, gradations and tiny random flecks
turn to noise at native 32x40. THIS IS THE ONE PRODUCTION CORRECTION:
each figure should appear drawn on an ACTUAL 32 by 40 pixel grid, enlarged
nearest-neighbour. Visible BIG SQUARE PIXELS with connected 3-6 pixel colour
clusters. Limit to 12 COLOURS per character. No soft shading, no photographic
texture, no outlines finer than one native pixel, no dithering. The game is
dark, so make cloth and metal broad MIDTONE planes edged with dark ink and
ash highlights, not black-on-black. Shading is two-tone shape design.

Technical layout: transparent alpha, exactly two rows, four columns, wide clear
gutters. Full body, facing RIGHT, same model and scale repeated in row. Columns
idle, breathing idle, walking left-forward, walking right-forward. Every pose
feet aligned. All shapes enclosed in cell, two-native-pixel minimum margin.
No captions/grid/ground/shadows/effects.

Kindler TOP: hood+orange scarf forms a lean diagonal silhouette; charcoal
workcoat ending above knees with a clear ochre belt separating torso from
trousers, small warm coal-lantern AT THE REAR BELT on left, clearly dark-grey
and ash-wrapped shins separated by negative space, planted boots. Visibly
sturdy FORWARD arm: shoulder at about x18 y16, elbow at x20 y20, a distinct
rounded empty leather gripping fist near x25 y18. Sleeve and forearm at least
THREE native pixels thick, not a single-pixel stick! Fist must not look like
another lantern or torch. There is NO primary weapon in the image; runtime
will attach a sword to this fist. Keep pointed hood small, no plate armor.

Warden BOTTOM: wider squared silhouette, squat closed steel helmet, big ash
pauldron, charcoal steel chest, subdued blue apron panel between two visibly
separate armoured legs, broad dark boots. Rectangular furnace-door shield on
far arm at the RIGHT, clipped lower corners, ash rim and ONE gold hinge. It
sits LOW (top at chest, bottom at shin) so free near-side fist can sit above
its top edge. Near-side arm bends forward: shoulder about x13 y15, elbow
x16 y19, EMPTY steel fist near x22 y16. Arm at least THREE native pixels thick,
clear elbow/gauntlet highlights, shield BEHIND that arm. Not a dangling hand
by hip. No sword/mace/torch drawn into any frame — runtime attaches a maul.
No filigree, no spiky shoulders, no crown; weathered utilitarian guard.

Palette: dark ink #141019, charcoal #2A2136, outline #3A3148, mid-ash #9A8FA0,
ash highlight #EDE6DA, ember #F08A2C, gold #E8C24A, muted block-blue #5B8DD9
and a SMALL number of darker tints. Large contiguous readable clusters.
Silhouette/anatomy over tiny detail. Proper little game sprites, not paintings.
refinement_reason: Coarser value grouping and anatomically clear free grip; one refinement.
